description: Core sync engine that fetches all starred GitHub repositories via the authenticated GitHub REST API (Octokit, paginated at 100/page), then clones new repos and pulls existing ones to the target directory. Reports per-repo success/failure summary at the end of each run. Exits with code 0 on full success, code 1 on any fetch or clone/pull failure, and code 2 on usage errors.
notes: Backfilled by feature-coverage-audit from current implementation evidence on 2026-06-10.
cloneOrPull is exported from src/index.ts and has unit test coverage.
Uses execFileSync with argv arrays — no shell injection risk.
Authenticates via GITHUB_TOKEN loaded by Bun-native .env auto-loading.

Revision 1.1.0 (2026-06-11): git subprocesses migrated to execFileSync argv arrays; fetch and clone/pull failures now propagate to exit code 1; per-repo success/failure summary added; cloneOrPull exported and now verifies remote.origin.url before pulling.
spec:
1. Verify `bun run sync` fetches all starred repos via GitHub API and clones missing repos / pulls existing repos to the target directory.
2. Verify exit code is 0 when all operations succeed.
3. Verify exit code is 1 when the GitHub API fetch fails.
4. Verify exit code is 1 when any individual clone or pull operation fails.
5. Verify exit code is 2 when unknown CLI arguments are provided.
6. Verify a per-repo success/failure summary is printed after sync.
7. Verify GITHUB_TOKEN is required and the tool exits with an error message when it is missing.
8. Verify cloneOrPull is exported from src/index.ts and has unit test coverage.
9. Verify cloneOrPull verifies the remote URL before pulling: read remote.origin.url via execFileSync('git', ['-C', repoPath, 'config', '--get', 'remote.origin.url']) and compare it to repo.clone_url; on mismatch, log a console.warn (`Skipping ${repo.name}: remote URL mismatch (expected ${repo.clone_url})`) and record a SyncFailure with verb 'clone' and message 'Remote URL mismatch' — do NOT pull a same-named directory whose remote points to a different repo.
title: Starred Repo Sync Engine
